release_verification.runtime_caveat: Exact npm 7.0.0 is the development baseline only. It lacks the inspected main commit's network-guard fixes, and both revisions still require the report-generator cache/coalescing bypass and no-retry patch. Production release requires a new fixed published driver, pinned and verified exactly.

requirements.description: The production driver release must include the network-guard fixes already present at inspected commit 89f636e276ea701412bb06039e3b963d83126ea1 in client-core.ts and config-validation.ts.

requirements.required_cache_behavior: Bypass GET cache reads, GET cache writes, and pending-request coalescing.
requirements.description: These GET endpoints generate reports and must execute independently for each explicit invocation without automatic retries. Both exact npm 7.0.0 and inspected main still require this driver patch.

Select the newly published fixed driver version, pin that exact version with a committed lockfile, and reverify endpoint bindings and runtime regression checks against its published package. An unpinned Git dependency is not an acceptable production substitute.
